reviewDecisions.rationale: A large, policy-directed investor-base shift is economically material even though current V1.9 may later fail company-level mapping; retain to measure opportunity-ontology misses.
A funded cross-category demand program can create direct company revenue/profit conversion and was absent from the legacy 2025 event census.
Multi-year non-China capacity constraints can shift pricing/orderbooks toward Chinese yards; company mapping and absorption must be checked.
The same tariff shock can hurt or spare exporters depending on pricing power and geographic mix; heterogeneous company mapping is researchable.
Outbound licensing acceleration is a cross-company monetization mechanism not represented in the old 2025 event pool; upfront versus contingent economics require strict verification.
Policy changes producer behavior and supply timing; deep research must determine whether it improves or worsens listed breeder economics.
A feedstock-cost advantage plus new capacity can alter relative margins across the chemical chain; direct company conversion and durability need testing.
The public hub independently surfaced the shortage, but it is a continuation of the already-frozen Q4 memory-tightness cluster and must not inflate independent opportunity frequency.
